title: Mn–Fe3O4 heterogeneous Fenton catalytic oxidation: mechanism and performance in sauce-flavored liquor wastewater degradation
content:

Benfu Luo, Jie Yu, Yujing Yan, Weiwei Huang, Jinyin Li, Yuhang Liu, Xi Yang, Xiang Zhou, Haiyan Ning
This study aims to investigate the mechanism and performance of synthesized Mn–Fe3O4 catalysts in the deep degradation of COD in sauce-flavored liquor wastewater by heterogeneous Fenton oxidation.
